card.line: Thyatira was a city of Asia Minor known for dyeing cloth. It was Lydia's hometown and the home of one of the seven churches in Revelation.

moments.title: Lydia of Thyatira
moments.text: Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira, listened to Paul's message at a place of prayer. The Lord opened her heart, and she and her household were baptized.

moments.title: Sent to seven churches
moments.text: Jesus told John to write what he saw and send it to seven churches. Thyatira was one of them.

moments.title: A letter to the church
moments.text: Jesus, the Son of God, with eyes like blazing fire, praised the church's love, faith, service, and perseverance. He also warned them about Jezebel, who misled His servants.

moments.title: Hold fast until I come
moments.text: Jesus spoke to the rest in Thyatira who did not follow Jezebel's teaching. He asked them to hold fast to what they had until He comes.
